modes.name: Plan
modes.note: writes only the plan, until you click Build

modes.name: Allowlist
modes.note: only allowlisted actions run; edits in the workspace never ask

modes.name: Allowlist (with Sandbox)
modes.note: many commands run on their own inside the sandbox; allowlisted actions run

run_modes.default_note: Agent; Auto-review is the run mode's default from 3.6

sandbox.how: used where possible in Auto-review; off in Run Everything; sandbox.json

scopes.name: You, every repo
files: user rules, kept in Cursor's settings

folders.how: Nested AGENTS.md files apply to their subfolders; .mdc rules can be scoped by file glob

models.default: not stated; Auto is the recommended everyday choice

set_by.file: the model picker in the chat (Cmd+/); CLI: --model

models.how: Pick Auto, Cursor's own models, or Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI and other vendors' models in the chat's picker (about 60 in all); you can also add your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure OpenAI or Bedrock key for chat.

proj-instructions.how: .cursor/rules/*.mdc, AGENTS.md at the repo root, and CLAUDE.md at the root (always applied)

personal-instructions.how: User rules in Cursor settings (Agent chat only)

folder-instructions.how: Nested AGENTS.md files apply to their subfolders; .mdc rules can be scoped by file glob

live-injection.how: A sessionStart hook (in hooks.json or Claude Code's settings) returns additional_context; beforeSubmitPrompt can only block a prompt

contracts.how: Rules applied by description or file globs

modes.how: Agent, Ask, Plan and Debug built in; the old custom modes are replaced by skills used as a mode

plan-first.how: Plan Mode researches, asks questions and writes an editable plan before any code; Shift+Tab to switch

commands.how: Markdown prompt files in .cursor/commands, run by typing / in Agent; skills can also be made explicit-only

git-workflow.how: CLI config switches the 'Made with Cursor' commit trailer and PR footer on or off

review-workflow.how: Agent Review checks local changes (quick or deep, on demand or after commits); Bugbot reviews PRs

skills.how: .cursor/skills, .agents/skills or ~/.cursor/skills (SKILL.md); also Claude Code's and Codex's skill folders, in the repo and home

plugins.how: Plugins bundle rules, skills, agents, commands, MCP servers and hooks; official and team marketplaces

connected-accounts.how: Remote MCP servers and marketplace plugins sign in with OAuth; no named personal mail/calendar/drive connectors

subagents.how: Built-in Explore, Bash, Browser; custom in .cursor/agents

orchestration.how: Subagents can start subagents two levels deep (from 2.5); /multitask runs them in parallel, each in its own worktree or cloud VM

autonomous-runs.how: Cloud agent automations, scheduled or triggered

model-routing.how: Each custom subagent can name its own model in frontmatter (default inherits the parent's)

setup.how: A setup script, or .cursor/environment.json for cloud agents

pins.how: A lockfile and a runtime version file in the repo

settings-split.how: Checked-in project files under .cursor/ versus personal ones under ~/.cursor; no personal per-project file documented

env-keys.how: MCP config takes env, envFile and ${env:NAME} interpolation; cloud agents get secrets as env vars

managed-policy.how: Enterprise MDM hooks.json and team hooks take top priority; admins can enforce team rules and run-mode settings

permissions.how: Run modes: Auto-review (the default from 3.6: allowlisted calls run, a checker model judges the rest), Allowlist, or Run Everything; permissions.json holds terminal and MCP allowlists and instructions for the checker; Ask every time was deprecated in 3.5

hard-gate.how: A preToolUse or beforeShellExecution hook that exits 2, in hooks.json or Claude Code's settings.json

secrets-out.how: .cursorignore blocks files from Agent (.env ignored by default); terminal and MCP can still read them; CLI Read() deny rules

sandbox.how: Commands run in the sandbox where possible in Auto-review; optional in Allowlist, off in Run Everything; sandbox.json (network denied by default)

network-limits.how: Sandbox network: listed domains only, list plus defaults, or allow all; admins can set it team-wide

spend-limits.how: Monthly on-demand spend limits per user, team or group; AI stops for that user at the limit

human-gate.how: Approval steps written into rules or skills; protections that ask even in automatic modes (file deletion, browser, files outside the workspace)

notifications.how: CLI 'notifications' setting alerts when the agent finishes or needs input

completion-check.how: A stop hook (in hooks.json or Claude Code's settings) whose followup_message, or a Claude-style block decision, sends it back

rewind.how: Automatic local checkpoints before big changes; restore files from the chat timeline; CLI /rewind

check-commands.how: Scripts in package.json or a Makefile, named in rules

auto-fix.how: afterFileEdit hook fires after Agent edits a file; docs use it to run a formatter

independent-checker.how: Bugbot PR review (off by default), or a reviewer subagent

visual-check.how: Browser tool is documented for testing apps and verifying visual changes with screenshots

harness-checker.how: Free Rein's checks (/address-findings), with a Cursor adapter (not built)

criteria.how: A done_when field on each task, read from files

event-log.how: An afterFileEdit or postToolUse hook that appends to a log

receipts.how: A sessionEnd hook that writes a summary

transcripts.how: Shared transcripts live in the dashboard and can be deleted; local storage location and retention not documented

status-line.how: CLI supports a custom statusLine command shown in the prompt footer

telemetry-export.how: No OpenTelemetry export documented for local use

cost-tracking.how: CLI /usage shows plan usage and on-demand spend; team dashboard has usage pages

session-state.how: A state file kept by hooks

task-list.how: Agent keeps a to-do list it can read (mentioned in release notes); persistence not documented

saved-facts.how: Automation memories for cloud automations; none for local agents

progress-log.how: A progress file named in rules

session-recall.how: CLI /resume picks a past chat; Agents Window searches past transcripts

decisions.how: A decisions file in the repo
